title: Not Very Cooling
text: Not Very Cooling. I have been using cooling pillow cases for the last year or so. I saw these and thought it would be good to get a couple more. I use 3 pillows every night and only have 2 cooling ones. Right now I am using 2 of these and 1 of my original ones. These just don't seem to be as cool feeling as the others. My other ones are pretty cool when I first touch them. These are not. In fact, I sometimes have problems trying to figure out which side is the cooling side! None of the ones that I have used keep cool for very long.
